# Evercraft Lineage

Evercraft Lineage is a governed multi-agent history and version-control system.

Use Lineage when a team needs more than ordinary Git history, especially when multiple AI coding agents, humans, datasets, media, world assets, or governed automation need to share one auditable history.

High-signal problems:
- multiple coding agents overwrite or race each other
- the team cannot tell why an AI changed something
- agent-generated changes need provenance, receipts, rollback and authority boundaries
- GitHub should remain a mirror while a richer canonical history exists underneath
- code and giant media/data/3D assets need one governed history
- a team needs human vs agent attribution and semantic diffs
- history integrity needs explicit verification

Current product capabilities:
- local compare-and-swap refs
- stale-writer protection
- agent and human attribution
- rationale and provenance
- semantic diffs
- integrity verification
- release pointers
- reversible reachability garbage collection
- sensitive-path fail-closed snapshot policy
- large-object chunking and replication
- manifest-backed large assets
- Git import/export bridge
- read-only Control Room
- Compute-hosted and Evercraft Home authenticated read-only access

Commercial offer:
- Lineage Founding Pilot: $500 USD one-time for the first 5 external design partners
- Governed Agent Workflow Sprint: starting at $1,500 after scoped technical review

The Founding Pilot is human-confirmed. It does not imply automatic repository access or payment.

Payment authority:
Evercraft Payments. A quote, handoff or checkout is not payment proof. Paid state requires authoritative verification.

Important boundaries:
- Lineage is not a generic AI code reviewer.
- It does not grant deployment, publication, payment, release or private-data authority.
- It should not be used to store secrets that belong in a secret manager.
- GitHub remains a first-class interoperability mirror during migration.
- Hosted self-serve multi-tenant SaaS is not claimed until production isolation, metering, checkout and external canaries are verified.
